note: Per-case total_tokens of the two matched control arms of main-text Table 4. Each arm was run over the same 87 CPC cases and the same five seeds; every row carries a total_tokens field, so the mean ± SD below is pooled over all case-seed rows (n = 87 x 5 = 435). A×5 uses the Borda-aggregated list (top5) of the five samples per case-seed; the total is the sum of the tokens of those five calls, not of a sixth aggregation call.

A×5.description: Borda aggregation of five independent samples (T=0.7), total_tokens summed over the five calls of each case-seed

A×1+CoT.description: single call with a short step-by-step justification before the ranked list, total_tokens of that call
A×1+CoT.reasoning_note: The A×1+CoT rows also carry reasoning_chars; across the 435 calls the justification averaged 2,713 characters (minimum 982; no empty justification).
